name: Hidden Blade - Oblivious Cat
steps: Meet Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine after Itō tells you about Kōetsu. He gives you the painting, Paintbrush and Inkwell.
Examine the cat beside Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Cross. Then choose option 1, about the cat keeping its prey behind it.
source: pac_ST_GION.bin actor 007c01b0 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910500.par, 910501.par, 910502.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Spectacular Squirrel
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat, report back to Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine to collect the painting.
On Forest Path, interact with the squirrel observation spot at the map pin.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Cross → Triangle. Then choose option 3, about being distracted by something overhead.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_RINDO.bin actor 007c01af and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910400.par, 910401.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Fang and Blade - Two Bones
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat, reach level 15 and speak to Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine for the painting.
Examine the dog on Yamato Alley South in Rakugai.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Triangle. Then choose option 3, about using two bones instead of one.
source: pac_ST_RAKUGAICHO.bin actor 007c01b9 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 911800.par, 911801.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Certain Death - True Dual Sword Dance
steps: After Kōetsu tells you about the bandits in his basement, complete substory #18, Water from the Ladle 1, to receive the portrait. Any answer in that substory gives you the portrait.
Watch the woman with two fans outside Tsuruya’s rear entrance in Gion.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Triangle → Square → Circle. Then choose option 3, about the dancer leaving no opening.
source: pac_ST_GION.bin actor 007c01b6; pac_ST_RAKUGAICHO.bin actor 00020239 checks CHAPTER05 state 52 for substory #18; uid0102054f.msg awards the portrait on all three branches; yact_all.par 911100.par, 911101.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Heavy Sword - Monkey Drop
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat and finishing the greatsword tutorial, reach level 17 and get the painting from Shichigoro. Eat four times at Shirohebi Udon in Rakugai for Ticket (Leaping Monkey).
Use the ticket at Rakugai’s Sideshow Tent and choose “An Extraordinary Trick! The Amazing Jumping Monkey!” The first showing is free with the ticket. Later showings cost 50 mon.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Cross → Triangle. Then choose option 2, about how high the little monkey jumps with a pole.
source: uid00b00004.msg (ticket), uid00b00040.msg (show) and pac_ST_MISEMONO.bin; yact_all.par 911000.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Certain Death - Dancing Cat
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat and finishing the greatsword tutorial, reach level 18 and collect the painting from Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine.
At Kiyomizudera Entrance, examine the cat beside the temple approach.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: 2 × Triangle. Then choose option 2, about the cat scaling the rock with its leaps.
source: pac_ST_KIYOMIZU_JNT.bin event 017c06e4 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 911300.par, 911301.par, 911302.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Heavy Sword - Karakuri Spin
steps: Buy the schematic for 2,000 mon from the man inside Ebisuya Pawn in Gion.
Take the schematic to Gyotensai at Gyotensai's House in Gion and speak to him about the clock.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Circle → Triangle → Cross → Square → Circle. Then choose option 3, about how the parts work together to create movement.
source: pac_ST_HATSUMEIKA.bin event 017c02d6; pac_ST_SHICHIYA.bin actor 00b001fb and dialogue uid00b001fb.msg; yact_all.par 910900.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Diving Swallow
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat, check Shichigoro’s Chapter 6 letter and collect the painting at Gion Inari Shrine.
Go to the middle of the bridge in Kawaramachi, near the girl, and interact with the swallow observation spot.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Square → Triangle → Cross. Then choose option 3, about the swallow’s fast dive.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_RAKUNAI.bin actor 007c0333 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910300.par, 910301.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Ascending Fish
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat, check Shichigoro’s Chapter 6 letter and collect the painting at Gion Inari Shrine.
Speak to the fisherman at the marked spot beside the Kamo River on Riverside Path.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Triangle. Then choose option 2, about the fish’s scales catching the light as it rises.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_KAWA.bin actor 007c02e3 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910100.par, 910101.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Soundless Serpent
steps: Collect the painting from Shichigoro after his Chapter 7 letter. Collect Painting of a Kite first if he has both to hand out.
At the fork on Forest Path, examine the snake observation spot.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Triangle → Circle. Then choose option 1, about the snake striking instantly without warning.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_RINDO.bin actor 007c02e4 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910201.par, 910202.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Certain Death - Orochi Bladestorm
picture: Crude Painting of Yamata no Orochi
steps: Complete substory #53, Terakoya Homework - The Letter, to obtain the painting.
Listen to the picture storyteller with the children on Shijo Avenue in Rakugai, in front of the shrine.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Cross → Triangle → Circle → Triangle → Cross → Square. Then choose option 2, about the fierce attacks of Yamata no Orochi.
source: pac_ST_RAKUGAICHO.bin actor 007c0431; reward dialogue uid007c033d.msg; yact_all.par 911500.par, 911501.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Snatching Kite
steps: After learning Oblivious Cat, check Shichigoro’s Chapter 7 letter and collect the painting at Gion Inari Shrine.
Speak to the man looking skyward on Mountain Path.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Circle → Triangle. Then choose option 2, about the kite snatching a sparrow from its flock.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_YAMA.bin actor 007c01b1 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910600.par, 910601.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Fang and Blade - Dragon Catch
steps: Speak to the retired man sitting at the Riverside Tea House to get the painting.
At the same tea house, interact with the children at the marked spot and watch their scuffle.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Triangle. Then choose option 3, about the accidental flip against the opponent.
source: pac_ST_KAWA_JNT.bin actors 007c01b7/007c01b8 and dialogue uid00b0005b.msg; yact_all.par 911600.par, 911601.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Certain Death - Enmei
steps: Learn Two Bones first. In substory #75, Enkiridera, agree to stay after the first fight and finish the rest of the request to get the painting. Leaving early forfeits it.
Return to the dog on Yamato Alley South in Rakugai.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Circle → Triangle → Square → Cross → Circle. Then choose option 3, about the circle helping maintain an unwavering state of mind.
source: pac_ST_RAKUGAICHO.bin actor 007c02e7 and reward dialogue uid0102024b.msg; yact_all.par 911400.par, 911401.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Heavy Sword - Fly Swatter
steps: In substory #85, Gion’s Famous Doctor 2, agree to search for Ken-san and complete the request to get the diagram.
Examine the seated man behind Nonaka Tea House on the Yoshioka Dojo approach.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: 3 × Triangle. Then choose option 3, about the fly being crushed against a wall.
source: pac_ST_YOSHIOKA_JNT.bin actor 007c02e6; reward dialogue uid0102006c.msg; yact_all.par 910800.par, 910801.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Certain Death - Devastating Duo
steps: Reach level 25 and speak to Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine. He can give you the painting after the Sleeping Cat painting, before the countryside event opens.
Speak to the farmer at the marked spot on Countryside Path.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: Cross → Triangle. Then choose option 2, about the bull’s horns pinning the man in place.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_TANBO.bin actor 007c00cb and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 911200.par, 911201.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Hidden Blade - Raging Bull
steps: Learn Devastating Duo, then collect this second bull painting from Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine in Chapter 9.
Go to the farmer at the Raging Bull pin on Countryside Path and watch the bull charge.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: 3 × Triangle. Then choose option 3, about the bull building up power before charging.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_TANBO.bin actor 007c01b3 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 910700.par, 910701.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin

name: Fang and Blade - Illusory Wolf
steps: Reach level 30 and get the painting from Shichigoro at Gion Inari Shrine after the Running Bull painting.
At night, use the observation spot on Cliffside Path to look up at the wolf.
Follow the timed prompts in this order: 8 × Cross. Then choose option 2, about the wolf’s movement and power as it scales the cliff.
source: pac_ST_KAIDO_TANI.bin actor 007c0438 and Shichigoro dialogue uid007c03fa.msg; yact_all.par 911702.par; item_s.bin and ougi.bin
